analysis.visual-summary.py:
import json,math
from pathlib import Path
runs=json.loads(Path('test-results/s112-l4qa/visual/proof.json').read_text());out=[]
for r in runs:
 ss=r['trace']['samples'];best=[];best_tick=0
 for i in range(30,len(ss)):
  window=ss[i-30:i+1];common=set(p['id'] for p in window[0]['positions']);maps=[{p['id']:p for p in s['positions']} for s in window];bad=[]
  for id in common:
   a=maps[0][id];ps=[m.get(id) for m in maps]
   if all(p and not(-36<p['x']<2 and -22<p['z']<35.5) and math.hypot(p['x']-a['x'],p['z']-a['z'])<=.5 for p in ps):bad.append(ps[-1])
  if len(bad)>len(best):best=bad;best_tick=ss[i]['tick']
 ids=set(r['trace']['seenCorpses']);releases=r['trace']['releases'];live=[e for e in releases if e['health']>0]
 row={'tier':r['tier'],'zoom':r['zoom'],'sampleCount':len(ss),'endTick':ss[-1]['tick'],'peakLiving':max(s['living'] for s in ss),'peakDrawnLiving':max(s['drawn'] for s in ss),'permanentCorpseIds':sorted(ids),'missingPermanentCorpses':r['trace']['corpseMissing'],'missingNativeSamples':[{'tick':s['tick'],'ids':s['missing']} for s in ss if s['missing']],'releaseCalls':len(releases),'settledCorpseReleases':sum(e['id'] in ids for e in releases),'livingReleases':live,'visibleLivingReleases':[e for e in live if e['onScreen']],'exteriorStationary30s':{'definition':'Outside authored plaza for 31 consecutive one-second snapshots, each within 0.5 m of first position; not proof of navigation failure.','peakSimultaneous':len(best),'windowEndTick':best_tick,'actors':best},'errors':r['errors'],'captures':[{'second':c['second'],'file':c['file']} for c in r['captures']]};out.append(row)
Path('test-results/s112-l4qa/visual-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
print(json.dumps([{k:r[k] for k in ['tier','zoom','peakLiving','peakDrawnLiving','releaseCalls','settledCorpseReleases','livingReleases','exteriorStationary30s']} for r in out],indent=2))

#!/bin/sh
export E2E_PORT=4921 SCENE_PORT=4922 S112_BUILD=test-results/s112-l4qa/baseline L4_STORYLINE_CANDIDATE_ONLY=1 L4_STORYLINE_WHOLE_HOLD=1
S112_TIER=high L4_STORYLINE_PERF_OUT=test-results/s112-l4qa/baseline-high npx tsx tools/perf/s112-local.ts
high_rc=$?
S112_TIER=low L4_STORYLINE_PERF_OUT=test-results/s112-l4qa/baseline-low npx tsx tools/perf/s112-local.ts
low_rc=$?
printf 'baseline harness exits: HIGH=%s LOW=%s\n' "$high_rc" "$low_rc"
exit 0
